data.notes: As of current published listings, March 2027 has very few Bangkok music events confirmed this far ahead; club calendars and festival schedules appear largely unannounced.

events.title: Ben-Ja-Pet The Celebration Concert
events.summary: Ben Chalatit celebrates 25 years in music with a full-scale anniversary concert at UOB LIVE, Emsphere. The show is billed as his first major concert in 14 years, built around fan-favorite songs from across his career.

events.title: ELSEWHERE: DOTT, SEIJI, MARU
events.summary: A stronger Saturday-night selector bill at Elsewhere Bangkok featuring DOTT, SEIJI and MARU, listed for 11:30 PM on the venue’s official programme.

events.title: ELSEWHERE: DOTT
events.summary: DOTT headlines Elsewhere Bangkok’s Friday late-night slot, a solid local-scene electronic club night listed on the venue’s official programme.

events.title: ELSEWHERE: SaoTeknik + DJ Zombie
events.summary: Official Elsewhere Bangkok programme date pairing SaoTeknik and DJ Zombie for a 11:30 PM underground electronic club night.

events.title: ELSEWHERE: CIVIC BOYS
events.summary: CIVIC BOYS take over Elsewhere Bangkok for a late-night underground club session starting at 11:30 PM.

events.title: ELSEWHERE: CicE
events.summary: Late-night Elsewhere Bangkok electronic club session with CicE, starting at 11:30 PM; the venue notes entry details will be announced closer to the date.
